headline: Run governed email workflows on Gmail.
summary: Use Gmail as a durable communication channel inside AgentRuntime workflows: read threads, search inboxes, draft replies, send messages, and route human approvals without giving agents unbounded mailbox access.
cardSummary: Read, search, draft, send, and coordinate approvals in Gmail while AgentRuntime keeps workflow state.
authentication: Connect with Google OAuth credentials (client ID, client secret, and refresh token) scoped to the Gmail methods your workflow uses.
workflowStart: Start from AgentRuntime, a schedule, or an inbound event, then use Gmail for context, outbound communication, and approval checkpoints.

outcomes.title: Triage inbound mail
outcomes.description: Search and read threads, classify intent, and route high-priority messages into the right workflow branch.

outcomes.title: Draft before send
outcomes.description: Create draft replies for human review, then send or escalate when policy checks pass.

outcomes.title: Approval in email
outcomes.description: Request explicit human approval inside the mailbox boundary before sensitive actions continue.

howItWorks: Connect Gmail with OAuth credentials and an MCP instance scoped to the mailbox.
Reference the instance from mcp_call steps in Studio with explicit tool selection.
Apply rules, human_task gates, and audit trails around every send or reply.

configuration.description: Google OAuth client ID for the Gmail API integration.
Google OAuth client secret paired with the client ID.
Long-lived refresh token for the mailbox AgentRuntime should act on behalf of.
Verified sender address used in From headers for send and reply tools.

faq.question: Can agents send mail without human review?
faq.answer: Only if your workflow omits human_task gates. Most production patterns draft first or require approval before send tools run.

faq.question: Does AgentRuntime store mailbox content?
faq.answer: Workflow runs retain step outputs required for execution and audit. Retention policies follow your tenant configuration.

faq.question: Which Gmail account is used?
faq.answer: The OAuth credentials on the MCP instance determine the mailbox. Use user_id me for the authenticated account.
